description: Hold the shot for a moment — glides to a target (optional) and keeps micro-drift so the recorder keeps emitting frames (a dead-static hold gets its tail frames dropped). Use after captions, highlights, and zooms: 2000–3000ms is a good beat.

ms.description: Hold duration in milliseconds. Optional; default 2200. A good beat after a caption/highlight/zoom is 2000–3000.

target.description: CSS selector or visible text to glide the cursor to and rest on. Optional — omit to hold in place. Example: '.cta-button'.

name: studio_hold
